# Suture & Steel — Master Roadmap

*The Malison Hours* · generated by `node scripts/roadmap-index.mjs` — do not edit by hand.

**2609 tasks** across 13 workstreams · **1828 done** (70%) ·
**243 open** for the game now · **538 parked** ([09-parked.md](roadmap/09-parked.md)).

## Scope
The game is **five chapters**. The goal now is **the whole game, playable end to end on Windows**: every chapter's
story, operations and Malison Hours, the other disciplines, and the look. Store, demo, marketing, localisation,
voice, playtest rounds and other-people work is parked until that exists. The phase tags on tasks (M0, Demo,
Alpha, Beta, Release, Post) record where each was first planned; the **priority tiers** below are the order of work.

## Priorities

Open tasks in order of work (`docs/roadmap/priorities.json`). Anything open and not in a tier is backlog.

### 1 · Finish the story — 1 open, 34 done

Chapters III–V must play end to end: every scene to spec, every branch wired, every op authored, with the barks, codex and case notes that carry it.

- [ ] **NAR-0177** (L) Ch3–5 second draft — incorporates playtest notes and ending matrix; all scene ids wired in campaign data

### 2 · The other disciplines — 0 open, 35 done

Triage, interview, bone-setting and forensics have their core logic (src/surgery/disciplines.ts) but no scenes or campaign steps — and the trial (s5-2) and the dead man's pulse (s4-5) are written around them.


### 3 · Chapter III–V gameplay systems — 0 open, 22 done

The mechanics the late operations and Hours depend on: multi-patient ops, environment modifiers, lead chelation, the lock, slow-pulse vitals, and bots that can clear them.


### 4 · Look and feel — 3 open, 18 done

Trauma Center-grade clarity (docs/art/visual-pass.md), then the six late Hours' render sets and VFX, Chapter III–V locations, cast and patient busts, and organ surfaces.
